what: Corrects the unit/sub tags of the 41 TECH1_CSE_* questions that import_2026_tech1.py's regex classify() filed into Technical Paper I Unit 1 (Discrete Mathematics) or Unit 3 (Data Structures and Algorithms) but which are DBMS/SQL, networking, OS, computer graphics or OOP. Because classify() wrote the UNIT TITLE into `sub`, the tag carried no information and every by-topic consumer had to fall back on question text -- where 'relation' (DBMS), 'set of rules' (protocols) and 'set of points' (conics) all route into Sets, Relations and Functions.
homes: DBMS and networking have no home in the 2026 syllabus: TECH2 is E-Governance and TECH3 is Project Management/Aptitude. Their only accurate home is TECH1_LEGACY units 5 and 1, which is counts_for_merit:false -- so this deliberately demotes 30 questions out of merit mocks. Computer graphics and language-level OOP are in NO paper; they are parked in a new non-merit OFFSYL paper rather than forced into a wrong unit.
